1	15V176000	Honda	Accord	2014	JU6	AIR BAGS:PASSENGER SIDE FRONTAL	Honda (American Honda Motor Co.)	20130717	20140630	V	1900000	20150501	MFR	Honda (American Honda Motor Co.)	20150331	20150401		208	Honda is recalling certain model year 2014 Accord vehicles manufactured July 17, 2013, to June 30, 2014. The passenger side frontal air bag may be susceptible to moisture intrusion.	If the passenger side frontal air bag is susceptible to moisture intrusion, the air bag may not deploy as intended, increasing the risk of injury in the event of a crash.	Honda will notify owners, and dealers will replace the passenger side frontal air bag, free of charge. The recall began on June 19, 2015. Owners may contact Honda customer service at 1-888-234-2138. Honda's number for this recall is JU6.		0000000000000000000000001	Passenger Air Bag				
2	21V127000	Toyota	Camry	2018	21TB02	FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:FUEL PUMP	Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing	20170701	20190831	V	152000	20210315	MFR	Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing	20210225	20210301		301	Toyota is recalling certain 2018 Camry vehicles. The low-pressure fuel pump inside the fuel tank may fail.	If the fuel pump fails, the engine can stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash.	Toyota will notify owners, and dealers will replace the fuel pump with an improved one, free of charge. The recall began April 6, 2021. Owners may contact Toyota customer service at 1-888-270-9371. Toyota's number for this recall is 21TB02.		0000000000000000000000002	Fuel Pump				
3	22V953000	Ford	F-150	2021	22S73	ENGINE	Ford Motor Company	20200901	20221231	V	563000	20221220	MFR	Ford Motor Company	20221215	20221220		108	Ford is recalling certain 2021 F-150 vehicles. The engine may fail prematurely due to a valve issue.	An engine failure can cause an unexpected loss of motive power, increasing the risk of a crash.	Ford will notify owners, and dealers will inspect and replace the engine, as necessary, free of charge. The recall began January 23, 2023. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 22S73.		0000000000000000000000003	Engine
